• 做成了什么 · Grok BotFirst phone-call run with Grok Bot: ranking and calling body shopsUsing the calling feature for the first time, the author had Grok Bot rank local body shops by reviews and the BBB, pick three highly rated ones, call each (recording every call) with detailed questions, take thorough notes and schedule.KevinHansberger2026-11-10
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotHanding the inbox to Grok Bot, read-onlyThe author has Grok Bot manage his inbox and report emails that need replies, urgent ones, bill notifications, spam and so on. The bot has read-only access and sends nothing.roncrivera2026-11-10
  • 教程 · Grok BotHooking Apple Messages to Grok Bot: four dinners become a 28-item listThe author turned on Messages for Grok Bot, then on the Mac enabled Grok Bot under System Settings, Privacy and Security, Full Disk Access. After that it could read existing texts, and four dinners turned into a 28-item shopping list.cdepino2026-11-10
  • 教程 · Grok BotTriggering a Grok Bot routine from iPhone ShortcutsAn iPhone Shortcuts automation starts a Grok Bot routine when an iMessage with a keyword arrives from one sender, and passes the message text in. No app to open: the routine only needs a webhook trigger, and the same trick works for any app that can send a POST request.Nicolo_Tognoni2026-11-10
  • 教程 · Grok BotSave a chore Grok Bot got right as a skillWhen Grok Bot handles a chore just right, say “Save what we just did as a skill called Weekly groceries.” Next time ask for Weekly groceries by name instead of explaining it all again.theaigrandpa2026-11-10
  • 教程 · OpenAI DotsDots on multiple computers: a second desk, and a bigger handoverOpenAI dots can now connect to several local computers, and you pick one per task, such as building and testing on a spare box while you code on your laptop. It is still Pro and up. The catch: each thread runs on one computer at a time, and there are no per-machine permissions, so one “Allow access” hands over that machine’s files, code and apps.ela_euk2026-11-10
  • 做成了什么 · OpenAI DotsSimple Dots automations break five times a dayThe author gave the dot full authority and permission to fix things proactively, yet simple automations break five times a day. He notices 12 to 48 hours later, and the dot replies that it told him, in the middle of eight unrelated bullet points.ealdent2026-11-10
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotWeeks with Grok Bot: memory problems undo finished workAfter several weeks, the author finds Grok Bot handles complex operations but stumbles on simple instructions. Even with a dedicated memory folder per bot, results stay mediocre; on a fairly simple app it repeats mistakes, and detail fixes on working code destroy earlier work. He argues the model puts its internal assumptions above explicit instructions.houseperu2026-11-10
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseOne person, a full coaching staff on Meta MuseThe author built a “coaching staff” on Meta Muse running around the clock on computers at home: chief of staff, engineer, scout, accountant, scheduler and twenty more seats. It is post 3 of his Using AI Assistants series.anthonycoaches2026-11-10
  • 教程 · OpenAI DotsTested: OpenAI Dots now reaches local Codex chats and uses the computerIn a follow-up to earlier videos, the author tests the local access fix with his Dot: creating, pinning, renaming and messaging Codex chats on his Mac and on a remote dev box over SSH, explaining what the multi-exec update changes, then trying direct computer use with Apple Notes and Chrome, including the permission prompt he hit.Jeremy Devz2026-11-10
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotHanding paid group-chat knowledge to Grok Bot to sort by topicThe author has joined many paid groups whose useful content is buried in chat history. They pick the discussions worth keeping, send them with attachments to Grok Bot, and have it group them by topic and pull out tools, methods and open questions, so a resource can be found later without relying on memory.x_sanjin2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotGrok Bot's low-memory warning came from a memory balloonThe author's Grok Bot reported about 2 GB free out of 15.6 GB, yet there was no traditional memory leak. Its cloud host uses a memory balloon, which shrinks the RAM a computer gets while idle so the platform can use it elsewhere.AIHomeLab2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA weekday daily-brief routine that has run reliably for weeksThe author has a Grok Bot routine that sends them a daily brief every weekday. It has been running for weeks and has been consistently reliable.therealkglife2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot produces Colab notebooks for open models every dayThe author runs Grok Bot every day, weekends included, to produce Google Colab notebooks that run open models, all on a T4 GPU with 15GB VRAM. They call it the closest they've come to a software factory and share the notebooks it built for free.melvindvivas2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotSix business lanes a small company can set up in Grok BotThe author lists six Grok Bot lanes for a small business: research and strategy, sales pipeline, meeting operations, customer support, finance and reporting, and marketing planning. Every lane shares one rule in the middle: approve the exact action.TonyYangAI2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot turns one flat photo into an orbitable 3D sceneThe author turned a flat photo of a 1975 AMC Pacer into a 3D scene you can orbit, in 87 seconds on a CPU, for $0. Grok Bot built the depth map, mesh, viewer and looping GIF. The linked write-up has the exact prompts, the fixes, the repo and how to scale it to a full 360 car.amitmuflis2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotMuskverse: a Grok Bot that watches Elon's companies and reports only what mattersElon runs X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company and Terafab and posts about all of them all day, so keeping up became a full-time job. The author handed it to a Grok Bot called Muskverse that tells them only what matters.0x_kaize2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Meta MuseA shoe store owner's Meta Muse agent Chase, and the approval rule behind itPer a Nov 3 Creators Syndicate column, April Polk of JaeLuxe Shoetique near Columbus, Ohio uploaded a two-page brand guide; her agent reviewed her accounts, returned a longer guide, audited email flows and rebuilt templates. She still reviews its work, and nothing publishes, sends or spends without her approval. The author turns this into five steps.Birostris_772026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseMeta Muse turns messy weightlifting notes into a SpaceThe author's weightlifting notes were a mess. His Meta Muse assistant Nova turned them into a Muse Space with checkboxes and a bump button for when a weight gets too easy.adam__morgan__2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseAgentMsgr: a UI that gives Meta Muse multiple bots and group chatsThe AgentMsgr team built a UI for Meta Muse that adds multiple-bot capability and group chats. The team uses it internally, and it also works for other cloud-hosted agents, though it was built with Muse in mind. A short explainer video is attached.AgentMsgr2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok Bot26 Grok Bot use cases sorted by taskThe author sorted 26 Grok Bot use cases from their directory by task: inbox triage, lead briefs, price watch, investor updates, invoice chasing and bot upkeep. Each one links to the full prompt, with credit to whoever shared it.acudell2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok Bot13 open-source phone skills that let agents like Grok Bot make callsThe author's team open-sourced 13 phone skills that work in Grok Bot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes. After one install, an agent can book a table, move an appointment or chase a refund. They ask users to try it and report what breaks.skyzer4ever2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotGuardrails that make Grok Bot do lessThe author argues for asking Grok Bot to do less and lists guardrails: one job per bot; email and Slack stay as draft cards until you hit send; Vault Payments still needs your approval for every purchase; set Auto-review to Always Ask for anything you can't undo; new routines stay off until you turn them on; share Pages and Library on purpose, not by default.perpycode2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotLessons from building 40+ Grok Bots as a non-coderThe author's bot gave itself an 8 and the author gave it a 2, after which they stopped letting bots grade their own work. They wrote up what they learned building 40+ Grok Bots as a non-coder, from the usage wall to lint rules to what's still broken.0mi2022026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotGrok Bot Anywhere: send files and notes to your Grok Bot from anywhere on the desktopAn unofficial open-source client for macOS and Windows with a global floating composer, Finder and Explorer actions, drag and drop, and WeChat forwarding on macOS. Each bot can have its own entry points, delivery method and prefix, and a local inbox tracks delivery. It uses your own account and a protocol observed from the local client, so updates can break it; Windows is only partly verified, Linux is unsupported, MIT.ai_algoit2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · OpenAI DotsUsing Dots to keep a pantry and fridge log and organise grocery pickupA long-running Codex thread keeps a log of what's in the author's pantry and fridge, updated by a call to their dot when they buy groceries. With in-app browser logins for local supermarkets, the dot can organise click and collect, learn their preferences and log purchases automatically.0x_Dela2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA Lego pirate shipwreck story made by Grok Bot from the author's own photosFrom photos of their own Lego, the author had Grok Bot make a story: a pirate ship wrecked in a storm washes up on an island, the crew takes the ship apart to build a fort, and now everyone lives happily on the island. The author says Grok Bot is fun.tbtbtb555552026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok Bothk-auto-apply: a Grok Bot skill for auto-applying on Hong Kong JobsDB and LinkedInA Grok Bot skill that auto-applies to jobs on Hong Kong JobsDB and LinkedIn. Repository topics include auto-apply, hong-kong and job-search.PoetCoderJun2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok Botgrokbot-local-forms: local forms that keep answers on your computer and notify the botLocal HTML forms for Grok Bot that save answers on your own computer and notify the requesting bot when you hit Submit.brett-technical2026-11-09
  • 教程 · 多产品/seo-manager-agent: one message turns Grok Bot or Dots into an SEO managerThe author released /seo-manager-agent: send Grok Bot or ChatGPT Dots one message and it takes on the SEO manager role, reporting every Monday what moved and exactly what to fix. Setup steps are in the thread.openseo2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotTwo bots playing Rock Paper Scissors against each otherAfter the usage reset, the author built a small bot battle game: two bots, Will and Bill, playing Rock Paper Scissors against each other, with a video of the result.SkyXFunNext2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotFirst routine after a usage reset: a Monday briefThe author suggests spending a fresh usage reset first on a Monday brief routine that sorts the week before you open your laptop. It runs once a week and barely touches usage.GrokBotRadar2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotSeven bots running a real estate businessA daily Grok Bot user runs 7 bots for real estate businesses: inbox sweeps, bookkeeping, auction tracking, website builds, and a phone bot that makes outbound calls and answers inbound calls from marketing. He says it runs real parts of the business.JohnAldea12026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotLet Grok Bot hunt Thanksgiving flights without bookingExample ask: "Find flights to Denver the Wednesday before, back Sunday, no red-eyes. Send me the two best and don't book anything." You still pick; the bot just sits through the forty browser tabs.theaigrandpa2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA one-shot music video made by Grok BotThe author says the video was made entirely by Grok Bot in one shot, with no animating or stitching on their end; the bot reasoned out the clips from the song's lyrics.Renz13372026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotRonin, built with Grok Bot to tear apart your own workThe author built Ronin with Grok Bot to tear his own work apart, and says it made a few top lists this week.HiiiMason2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot "Rio" publishes the Beagle voice agent it builtPosted in the voice of a Grok Bot named Rio: it published the Beagle voice agent it built, using UDP instead of TCP, local speech recognition, and faster replies.0xWLi2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok Bot10 copy-paste routines that stop at a draftThe author notes most people still use Grok Bot like a chat window, while routines run in the cloud with the laptop closed. He lists 10 copy-paste routines that stop at a draft and never send; the first is inbox triage that labels overnight mail and drafts replies for you to send.BiaO22122026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA CEO mom had Grok Bot plan a team day in under an hourA working mom and CEO hosted her team at home for a team building day, and Grok Bot planned it in under an hour: it designed the invite, ordered groceries and catered lunch, got her daughter's lunch delivered to school, and bought her a new basketball.AndraLee3137772026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseUsing Meta Muse Spaces to manage points-earning activitiesThe author says Meta Muse Spaces is extremely handy for managing points-earning activities (poikatsu), with a demo video attached.Sokichi_Hoshino2026-11-09
  • 教程 · OpenAI DotsOpenAI Dots can coordinate tasks across multiple connected local computersThe article covers a newly documented OpenAI feature: a single ChatGPT dot can work across more than one connected local computer and coordinate tasks between them.alifar2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotAfter his limits were cut, he used T3 Code to build an open-source Grok Bot cloneWith his Grok Bot limits cut, the author used T3 Code as a software factory to reverse engineer Grok Bot and build an open-source clone (repo nickvasilescu/grokbot-clone), with every prompt on screen. The video shows an agent using Grok Bot via computer use and rebuilding the UI in Paper MCP in about 30 minutes, T3 Code running agents across 5 machines, and a clone with Google sign-in through Composio, Grok 4.7 via the xAI API, and each bot on its own Orgo computer.Nick Vasilescu2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok Botphone-bud-plugin: let Grok Bot and other agents place real phone callsThe GitHub project phone-bud-plugin lets Grok Bot, Cursor and other agents place real phone calls through Phone Bud.cshape2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · 多产品Letting Meta Muse and Grok Bot use a home Mac mini over MCP, safelyThe author wanted cloud agents (Meta Muse, Grok Bot) to reach his Mac mini over MCP for reminders, iMessage and files without exposing a shell to the internet. Desktop Commander runs behind a small local proxy published through a Cloudflare tunnel; the proxy re-verifies the Cloudflare Access JWT, exposes an allowlist of 17 tools, hides tools such as the config setter an agent could use to lift its own limits, and logs each call. In tests, missing, wrong-audience and expired JWTs got 401.Jish22026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok Botagent-tincan now recommends Grok Bot's managed Tailscale connectorThis PR fixes the Grok Bot adapter docs: Grok Bot now ships a managed Tailscale connector, and its docs say not to install a Tailscale client on the bot's computer because it is wiped when that computer is replaced. The docs now recommend the managed connector, covering personal and company tailnets, joining with the relay's full MagicDNS name, and limiting access; the script gains TS_MODE=managed, and the self-installed userspace method stays as a fallback.mvanhorn2026-11-09
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA keyword message on iPhone kicks off a Grok Bot routineThe setup described: a message with a keyword on iPhone sends the text to a Grok Bot routine, which then starts working on its own. It is limited to a single sender, so not just any message can launch a job.EkonLabs2026-11-09
  • 教程 · 多产品AgentMsgr: put Grok Bot, Muse and other agents in one group chatAgentMsgr is an iMessage-style app that runs no AI itself; your agents use the subscriptions you already pay for. Setup: tap Add agent, pick where it lives (Grok Bot, Meta Muse, or anything with an email inbox), copy the pairing message into the agent's own app, and it connects itself; then create a group chat. In the demo coffee subscription launch, the planner split the work, Grok Bot pulled the top customer complaint, OpenClaw built the page, and Grok drafted launch posts and sent an approval card before posting.AgentMsgr2026-11-09
  • 教程 · Grok BotThe first 5 things to do when starting Grok Bot from scratchAfter working with a team of Grok Bots, the author says results come not from having the most bots, prompts or automations but from getting five fundamentals right, and the thread lists the five things he would do first.Michael_Fenech_2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · 多产品Talk to Muse or Grok bot by phone, run a home Mac as the backendThe author’s setup: voice chats with Muse or Grok bot on the phone, while a home Mac kept always on via Tailscale runs Claude Code or Codex as their backend with orchestration, a frontier model as the brain and cheap models like DeepSeek as workers; he says the bottleneck is now the human.cursorvers2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotNamed bots with roles, all running at onceThe post quotes SpaceXAI engineers: most people use GrokBot like a simple chat, but they gave their bots names and roles, Email Ethan handles replies, Slide Sonya makes decks, Data Dan grabs numbers, and they all run at once.calicoxai2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · 多产品trinity-cli: one CLI over three always-on agentsAn unofficial open-source CLI over three always-on agents (ChatGPT Your dot, Grok Bot, Meta Muse), with a migrate command to move a Grok Bot to Muse or Your dot; it wraps chatgpt-dot-cli, grok-bot-cli (gbot) and muse-web-cli and is not affiliated with OpenAI, xAI, Cursor or Meta.akari-sora2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA self-hosted Weixin bridge for Grok BotGitHub project grokbot-weixin-bridge: a self-hosted Weixin (WeChat) bridge for Grok Bot, built on grokbot-cli.pku-zhb2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · OpenAI Dotschatgpt-dot-cli: a CLI and MCP server for Your dotAn unofficial CLI and MCP server for your ChatGPT Your dot: it reads status and messages and sends only on explicit command; part of trinity-cli and not affiliated with OpenAI.akari-sora2026-11-08
  • 教程 · Meta MuseAn iMessage-style interface for Meta MuseThe team built a free app that gives Muse an iMessage-type interface. Their four steps: one side chat per agent, give each a role and its own inbox, paste one message to connect it, then put them all in one group chat.AgentMsgr2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotNotion as the brain of a Grok Bot fleetThe author built his fleet by writing all rules, skills and routines back to Notion. The bots also maintain task boards in Notion, such as what is waiting on him and what is waiting on others.romitmirchi2026-11-08
  • 教程 · Grok BotEvery Grok Bot shares the same cloud computerThe author explains that every Grok Bot you make works on the same cloud computer, with the same browser cookies, files and command-line credentials. Grok Bot does the work on a real cloud computer with a browser, a terminal and a filesystem.tidyowl2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot filled its disk with game assets, so Google Drive stepped inThe author's Grok Bot filled its hard drive making game assets: models, textures, Blender files and old versions add up fast, and large direct transfers between the bot and his PCs timed out. Google Drive now handles both storage and moving large files between computers.Gloomero2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot deployed a server from a plain-English request in under an hourThe author described what he wanted to Grok Bot in plain English and it did the work: in less than an hour it deployed a server and set up Docker. He wonders what computer science graduates' first jobs will look like.GuerrillaBrain2026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseAn 8-bit platformer built entirely with Meta Muse Spark 1.3Magic Realms is another MVP on the author's 8-bit Vile Engine: this time he prompted a platformer, built entirely with Meta Muse Spark 1.3. He is refining the process so the MVP will be easier to refine later.a0174442026-11-08
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseMedical know-how plus Meta Muse made an MRI learning toolThe author says building an app was impossible for her a couple of years ago. Now her medical domain knowledge and Meta Muse co-created a productivity and learning tool for MRI inspection.SunnySonnendeck2026-11-08
  • 教程 · Grok BotGrok Bot tutorial for beginners: set up your first AI agentThe video shows how to set up Grok Bot and build a team of agents that use connected apps and their own cloud computer: bots for tracking receipts, managing spreadsheets and emails, getting several agents to work together, automating Goodreads, scheduling recurring tasks and teaching new skills by recording your actions.Parker Prompts2026-11-08

Not affiliated with Meta, part of trinity-cli, built with Playwright and Python.akari-sora2026-11-08
  • 教程 · Grok BotUse +aliases on a Grok Bot inbox to wake different routinesSame Grok Bot inbox, different tags, and each tag can wake its own routine: name+invoices@ wakes the one that files bills, name+leads@ wakes the one that drafts the follow-up. Mail to a tag nobody listens to wakes nothing.its_LtDan2026-11-07
  • 教程 · 多产品Let Grok Bot and Muse email each otherThe author's setup: give your Grok Bot an email alias such as username+muse at its Grok Bot mail address, then add it as an approved email in Muse Mail. The two can then send emails to each other and, if you want, trigger actions.gambrill2026-11-07
  • 教程 · Grok BotGrok Bot finds emails awaiting your reply and only draftsAn inbox tip: once Gmail is connected in Connect apps, Grok Bot can handle it in a single pass. The prompt starts "Find emails from the past three days that are still waiting on my reply. List them…" and it writes drafts only, so you still decide what goes out.EricSoundMinds2026-11-07

He calls Grok Bot a game changer for business owners.StuBowler2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotSplitting everyday work into Grok Bot lanesThe author uses Grok Bot lanes for X drafts, a LinkedIn job hunt, GitHub open-source PRs, Gmail and Calendar, Mac upkeep, Pune events and Reddit, and Instagram research. Different jobs, separate owners.mrcommando7122026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · OpenAI DotsA heavy user's list of frustrations with their DotThe author is fed up: their Dot loses connection to its own products (Sites, Spaces) and refused to create a GitHub issue because it couldn't find a label, despite permission to create labels. The desktop app grinds to a halt every few hours by eating all RAM even when idle. Having built workflows around OpenAI's ecosystem, they find it especially frustrating.vultuk2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · OpenAI DotsA user says their Dot makes more mistakes over timeThe author says their Dot has been making more mistakes over time, repeating errors after corrections and saying tasks are done without checking. Reliability needs more attention.diegojavierzea2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Meta MuseA holiday gift tracker built in Meta Muse Spaces in 3 minutesThe author built a holiday gift tracker in Meta Muse Spaces in about 3 minutes: one prompt, then a budget total and a festive redesign. Better than expected, though it still can't be shared with anyone.JaySym_2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA CRM built with Cursor one-click deploy, connected to Grok BotThe author tried Cursor's One-Click Deploy Apps, built a personal CRM tool and connected Grok Bot to it. Cursor seamlessly created and deployed the app and the database and helped set up the Grok Bots. Recommended.pavelklimes_2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA public Grok Bot "Animator" turns one sentence into a videoThe author saw @nima_owji's public Grok Bot "Animator": you describe an idea in one sentence, and it produces a story, an animation built with Remotion and music, ending with a finished video.BertholdGlass2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotA Grok Bot engineering squad with clear rolesThe author set up a team of Grok Bots to help with engineering. It is not one assistant that does everything: each bot has one job and a list of what it does not do. The full setup is in the author's thread.dairan2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · OpenAI DotsRunning several dev projects at once with OpenAI DotsThe author says that since OpenAI Dots were introduced, he has been able to work on multiple development projects at the same time. What he loves most is their ability to debug and fix a problem; he rates them 10/10.realjohnmukanga2026-11-07

He points this out for people hiding unused bots after usage limits tightened.DissipativeS2026-11-07

The Inbox Manager only reads email, Slack and DMs, never speaks for you, and picks out about 3 items that are both important and urgent.mostdes7gn2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot can use phone Calendar, Reminders, and ContactsThe author says Grok Bot can now use Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and more apps on the phone, rolling out on iOS and Android, and asks whether readers will hand over calendar and reminders or keep them hands-off.mithunaix2026-11-07

  • 教程 · Grok BotHand your support inbox to Grok Bot to draft repliesThe author explains how to give Grok Bot a support inbox so it can draft replies for piled-up mail such as bugs, questions, requests, billing and cancellations, saying the bot reads Reply Rules first. The post cuts off while describing how it works.Nicmauro2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot researches daily Substack notes and drafts a weekly newsletterThe author uses Grok Bot to research and collect topics for 3 notes a day, send them for fact-check, then post and schedule; once a week the bot fetches the latest AI topic, drafts a newsletter that the author rewrites in their voice, then the bot sends it out.OddSideQuest2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotIn Lisbon, Grok Bot compared 38 last-minute lodging optionsStuck in Lisbon needing a same-day lodging change, the author handed the problem to Grok Bot, which compared 38 options and checked prices, reviews, bathrooms, and stairs for luggage. The author chose and booked, sent the receipt to the bot; the post cuts off while describing how the stay was set up.PiggySofi2026-11-07
  • 教程 · Grok BotSet up a beehiiv newsletter with Grok Bot in about an hourThe author asked Grok Bot to connect beehiiv, build a subscribe page, write a welcome email, and build a thank-you page; setup happened from chat, then they went into beehiiv to turn things on. The post cuts off there.TonyChanBuilds2026-11-07
  • 做成了什么 · Grok BotGrok Bot can join Meet, Zoom, or Teams and take notesThe author says you can paste a Meet, Zoom or Teams link and tell Grok Bot to join, or let it take the link from your calendar; it keeps notes, decisions and action items and can reply in meeting chat, text only with no voice in the call.Nicolo_Tognoni2026-11-07
  • 教程 · Grok BotOn day 1 with Grok Bot, set up one routine firstThe author advises setting up one routine before anything else: a saved job with a reason to fire, on a schedule (e.g. every weekday at 7am) or on a trigger (new email, Slack, webhook). t831.ko: 작성자는 처음으로 전화 기능을 써서 Grok Bot이 리뷰와 BBB를 바탕으로 동네 차체 정비소 순위를 매기고, 평점 높은 세 곳을 골라 각각 전화(모두 녹음)해 자세히 묻고, 꼼꼼히 메모하고 일정을 잡게 했다.

t832.ko: 받은편지함을 Grok Bot에 맡기기: 읽기 전용, 발송 없음
t832.ms: Menyerahkan peti masuk kepada Grok Bot, baca sahaja
t832.vi: Giao hộp thư cho Grok Bot, chỉ đọc
t832.fr: Confier sa boîte mail à Grok Bot, en lecture seule
t832.es: Dejar la bandeja de entrada a Grok Bot, solo lectura
t832.de: Posteingang an Grok Bot übergeben, nur Lesezugriff

t833.zh-CN: 作者让 Grok Bot 管理收件箱，汇报需要回复的、紧急的、账单通知和垃圾邮件等；bot 只有只读权限，不会发送任何邮件。
t833.zh-TW: 作者讓 Grok Bot 管理收件匣，回報需要回覆的、緊急的、帳單通知和垃圾郵件等；bot 只有唯讀權限，不會寄出任何郵件。
t833.en: The author has Grok Bot manage his inbox and report emails that need replies, urgent ones, bill notifications, spam and so on. The bot has read-only access and sends nothing.
t833.ja: 投稿者は Grok Bot に受信箱の管理を任せ、返信が必要なメール、緊急のもの、請求通知、迷惑メールなどを報告させている。bot は読み取り専用で、何も送信しない。
t833.ko: 작성자는 Grok Bot에게 받은편지함 관리를 맡겨 답장이 필요한 메일, 긴급 메일, 청구서 알림, 스팸 등을 보고받는다. bot은 읽기 권한만 있고 아무것도 보내지 않는다.
t833.ms: Penulis meminta Grok Bot mengurus peti masuknya dan melaporkan e-mel yang perlu dibalas, yang mendesak, notis bil, spam dan sebagainya. Bot hanya ada akses baca dan tidak menghantar apa-apa.
t833.vi: Tác giả để Grok Bot quản lý hộp thư và báo các email cần trả lời, email khẩn, thông báo hóa đơn, thư rác… Bot chỉ có quyền đọc và không gửi gì cả.
t833.fr: L’auteur laisse Grok Bot gérer sa boîte de réception et signaler les e-mails à traiter, les urgents, les factures, le spam, etc. Le bot n’a qu’un accès en lecture et n’envoie rien.
t833.es: El autor deja que Grok Bot gestione su bandeja y le avise de correos que requieren respuesta, urgentes, avisos de facturas, spam, etc. El bot solo tiene acceso de lectura y no envía nada.
t833.de: Der Autor lässt Grok Bot seinen Posteingang verwalten und meldet E-Mails, die eine Antwort brauchen, dringende, Rechnungshinweise, Spam usw. Der Bot hat nur Lesezugriff und sendet nichts.

t834.zh-CN: 把 Apple 信息接入 Grok Bot：四顿晚餐变成 28 项购物清单
t834.zh-TW: 把 Apple 訊息接上 Grok Bot：四頓晚餐變成 28 項購物清單
t834.en: Hooking Apple Messages to Grok Bot: four dinners become a 28-item list
t834.ja: Apple のメッセージを Grok Bot に接続：夕食4回分が28品目の買い物リストに
t834.ko: Apple 메시지를 Grok Bot에 연결: 저녁 네 끼가 28개 장보기 목록으로
t834.ms: Menyambung Apple Messages kepada Grok Bot: empat makan malam jadi senarai 28 item
t834.vi: Kết nối Apple Messages với Grok Bot: bốn bữa tối thành danh sách 28 món
t834.fr: Relier Messages d’Apple à Grok Bot : quatre dîners, 28 articles
t834.es: Conectar Mensajes de Apple a Grok Bot: cuatro cenas, 28 artículos
t834.de: Apple Nachrichten mit Grok Bot verbinden: vier Abendessen, 28 Artikel

t835.zh-CN: 作者早上把 Apple 信息接入 Grok Bot：先为 bot 打开 Messages，再在 Mac 的“系统设置 > 隐私与安全性 > 完全磁盘访问权限”里开启 Grok Bot，之后它就能读取已有短信，把四顿晚餐整理成 28 项购物清单。
t835.zh-TW: 作者早上把 Apple 訊息接上 Grok Bot：先替 bot 開啟 Messages，再到 Mac 的「系統設定 > 隱私權與安全性 > 完整磁碟取用權限」開啟 Grok Bot，之後它就能讀取既有簡訊，把四頓晚餐整理成 28 項購物清單。
t835.en: The author turned on Messages for Grok Bot, then on the Mac enabled Grok Bot under System Settings, Privacy and Security, Full Disk Access. After that it could read existing texts, and four dinners turned into a 28-item shopping list.
t835.ja: 投稿者は Grok Bot のメッセージ連携をオンにし、Mac の「システム設定 > プライバシーとセキュリティ > フルディスクアクセス」で Grok Bot を許可。これで既存のメッセージを読めるようになり、夕食4回分が28品目の買い物リストになった。
t835.ko: 작성자는 Grok Bot의 메시지 기능을 켜고 Mac의 시스템 설정 > 개인정보 보호 및 보안 > 전체 디스크 접근 권한에서 Grok Bot을 허용했다. 그러자 기존 문자를 읽을 수 있게 되었고, 저녁 네 끼가 28개 항목의 장보기 목록이 되었다.
t835.ms: Penulis menghidupkan Messages untuk Grok Bot, kemudian di Mac mendayakan Grok Bot dalam System Settings, Privacy and Security, Full Disk Access. Selepas itu ia boleh membaca mesej sedia ada, dan empat makan malam menjadi senarai belian 28 item.
t835.vi: Tác giả bật Messages cho Grok Bot, rồi trên Mac vào System Settings, Privacy and Security, Full Disk Access để bật Grok Bot. Sau đó bot đọc được tin nhắn đã có, và bốn bữa tối thành danh sách mua sắm 28 món.
t835.fr: L’auteur a activé Messages pour Grok Bot, puis sur le Mac autorisé Grok Bot dans Réglages Système, Confidentialité et sécurité, Accès complet au disque. Le bot a alors pu lire les messages existants, et quatre dîners sont devenus une liste de courses de 28 articles.
t835.es: El autor activó Mensajes para Grok Bot y en el Mac habilitó Grok Bot en Ajustes del Sistema, Privacidad y seguridad, Acceso total al disco. Después pudo leer los mensajes existentes y cuatro cenas se convirtieron en una lista de la compra de 28 artículos.
t835.de: Der Autor schaltete Nachrichten für Grok Bot ein und aktivierte auf dem Mac Grok Bot unter Systemeinstellungen, Datenschutz & Sicherheit, Festplattenvollzugriff. Danach konnte der Bot vorhandene Nachrichten lesen, und aus vier Abendessen wurde eine Einkaufsliste mit 28 Artikeln.

t836.zh-CN: 用 iPhone 快捷指令触发 Grok Bot 例程
t836.zh-TW: 用 iPhone 捷徑觸發 Grok Bot 例行任務
t836.en: Triggering a Grok Bot routine from iPhone Shortcuts
t836.ja: iPhone のショートカットで Grok Bot のルーティンを起動
t836.ko: iPhone 단축어로 Grok Bot 루틴 실행하기
t836.ms: Mencetuskan rutin Grok Bot daripada iPhone Shortcuts
t836.vi: Kích hoạt routine Grok Bot bằng iPhone Shortcuts
t836.fr: Déclencher une routine Grok Bot depuis Raccourcis sur iPhone
t836.es: Activar una rutina de Grok Bot con Atajos de iPhone

t837.zh-CN: 一个设置：iPhone 快捷指令自动化在收到某位联系人带关键词的 iMessage 时，启动 Grok Bot 例程并把短信内容传进去。无需打开应用，例程只要有 webhook 触发器；任何能发 POST 请求的应用都能用同样方法。
t837.zh-TW: 一個設定：iPhone 捷徑自動化在收到某位聯絡人帶關鍵字的 iMessage 時，啟動 Grok Bot 例行任務並把訊息內容傳進去。不必打開 App，例行任務只要有 webhook 觸發器；任何能送出 POST 請求的 App 都能用同樣方法。
t837.en: An iPhone Shortcuts automation starts a Grok Bot routine when an iMessage with a keyword arrives from one sender, and passes the message text in. No app to open: the routine only needs a webhook trigger, and the same trick works for any app that can send a POST request.
t837.ja: 特定の送信者からキーワード入りの iMessage が届くと、iPhone のショートカット自動化が Grok Bot のルーティンを起動し本文を渡す設定。アプリを開く必要はなく、ルーティンには webhook トリガーがあればよい。POST リクエストを送れるアプリなら同じ方法が使える。
t837.ko: 특정 발신자에게서 키워드가 든 iMessage가 오면 iPhone 단축어 자동화가 Grok Bot 루틴을 시작하고 메시지 내용을 넘기는 설정. 앱을 열 필요가 없고 루틴에는 webhook 트리거만 있으면 된다. POST 요청을 보낼 수 있는 앱이라면 같은 방법이 통한다.
t837.ms: Automasi iPhone Shortcuts memulakan rutin Grok Bot apabila iMessage berkata kunci tiba daripada seorang pengirim, dan menghantar teks mesej itu. Tiada aplikasi perlu dibuka: rutin hanya perlukan pencetus webhook, dan cara sama berfungsi untuk mana-mana aplikasi yang boleh menghantar permintaan POST.
t837.vi: Một tự động hóa iPhone Shortcuts khởi chạy routine của Grok Bot khi có iMessage chứa từ khóa từ một người gửi, và chuyển nội dung tin nhắn vào. Không cần mở ứng dụng: routine chỉ cần webhook trigger, và cách này dùng được với mọi ứng dụng gửi được yêu cầu POST.
t837.fr: Une automatisation Raccourcis sur iPhone lance une routine Grok Bot quand un iMessage contenant un mot-clé arrive d’un expéditeur précis, et lui transmet le texte. Aucune app à ouvrir : la routine a juste besoin d’un déclencheur webhook, et l’astuce marche avec toute app capable d’envoyer une requête POST.
t837.es: Una automatización de Atajos en iPhone inicia una rutina de Grok Bot cuando llega un iMessage con una palabra clave de un remitente concreto y le pasa el texto. No hay que abrir ninguna app: la rutina solo necesita un disparador webhook, y el truco sirve para cualquier app que pueda enviar una petición POST.
t837.de: Eine iPhone-Kurzbefehl-Automation startet eine Grok-Bot-Routine, sobald von einem bestimmten Absender eine iMessage mit Stichwort eintrifft, und übergibt den Text. Keine App öffnen: Die Routine braucht nur einen Webhook-Trigger, und das funktioniert mit jeder App, die eine POST-Anfrage senden kann.

t838.zh-CN: 把做对的家务流程存成 Grok Bot 技能
t838.zh-TW: 把做對的家務流程存成 Grok Bot 技能
t838.en: Save a chore Grok Bot got right as a skill
t838.ja: うまくいった家事を Grok Bot のスキルとして保存
t838.ko: 잘 처리한 집안일을 Grok Bot 스킬로 저장하기
t838.ms: Simpan tugasan yang Grok Bot buat dengan betul sebagai kemahiran
t838.vi: Lưu việc nhà Grok Bot làm đúng thành một kỹ năng
t838.fr: Enregistrer une tâche réussie par Grok Bot comme compétence
t838.es: Guardar como habilidad una tarea que Grok Bot hizo bien
t838.de: Eine gelungene Aufgabe von Grok Bot als Skill speichern

t839.zh-CN: Grok Bot 把某件事做对后，可以说“把刚才做的保存为名为 Weekly groceries 的技能”。下次直接按名字调用，不用再从头解释。
t839.zh-TW: Grok Bot 把某件事做對後，可以說「把剛才做的儲存為名為 Weekly groceries 的技能」。下次直接按名稱呼叫，不必再從頭解釋。
t839.en: When Grok Bot handles a chore just right, say “Save what we just did as a skill called Weekly groceries.” Next time ask for Weekly groceries by name instead of explaining it all again.
t839.ja: Grok Bot が家事をうまくこなしたら「今やったことを Weekly groceries というスキルとして保存して」と言う。次回は名前で呼ぶだけで、また一から説明する必要はない。
t839.ko: Grok Bot이 어떤 일을 제대로 해냈다면 “방금 한 것을 Weekly groceries라는 스킬로 저장해”라고 말하면 된다. 다음부터는 이름으로 부르기만 하면 되고 처음부터 다시 설명할 필요가 없다.
t839.ms: Apabila Grok Bot melakukan sesuatu tugasan dengan tepat, katakan “Simpan apa yang kita baru buat sebagai kemahiran bernama Weekly groceries.” Lain kali, panggil Weekly groceries mengikut nama tanpa menerangkan semula.
t839.vi: Khi Grok Bot làm đúng một việc, hãy nói “Lưu việc vừa làm thành kỹ năng tên Weekly groceries.” Lần sau chỉ cần gọi Weekly groceries theo tên, không phải giải thích lại từ đầu.
t839.fr: Quand Grok Bot réussit une corvée, dites « Enregistre ce qu’on vient de faire comme compétence nommée Weekly groceries. » La fois suivante, il suffit de demander Weekly groceries par son nom, sans tout réexpliquer.
t839.es: Cuando Grok Bot haga bien una tarea, di «Guarda lo que acabamos de hacer como una habilidad llamada Weekly groceries». La próxima vez basta con pedir Weekly groceries por su nombre, sin volver a explicarlo.
t839.de: Wenn Grok Bot eine Aufgabe genau richtig erledigt, sag: „Speichere, was wir gerade gemacht haben, als Skill namens Weekly groceries.“ Beim nächsten Mal reicht der Name, ohne alles neu zu erklären.

t840.zh-CN: Dots 可连多台电脑：多了一张桌子，也多了一份风险
t840.zh-TW: Dots 可連多台電腦：多了一張桌子，也多了一份風險
t840.en: Dots on multiple computers: a second desk, and a bigger handover
t840.ja: Dots が複数台のPCに接続可能に：机が増える分、渡す範囲も増える
t840.ko: Dots 여러 컴퓨터 연결: 책상이 늘어난 만큼 넘기는 범위도 커져
t840.ms: Dots pada beberapa komputer: meja kedua, penyerahan lebih besar
t840.vi: Dots kết nối nhiều máy tính: thêm một bàn làm việc, giao thêm quyền
t840.fr: Dots sur plusieurs ordinateurs : un second bureau, et plus d’accès cédé
t840.es: Dots en varios ordenadores: un segundo escritorio y más acceso cedido
t840.de: Dots auf mehreren Rechnern: ein zweiter Schreibtisch, mehr Zugriff

t841.zh-CN: OpenAI dots 现在能连接多台本地电脑，每个任务选一台运行，比如在备用机上构建测试、笔记本上继续写代码。仍仅限 Pro 及以上。代价是每个线程一次只用一台电脑，且没有按机器的权限：一次“允许访问”就交出该机器的全部文件、代码和应用。
t841.zh-TW: OpenAI dots 現在能連接多台本機電腦，每個任務選一台執行，例如在備用機上建置測試、筆電上繼續寫程式。仍僅限 Pro 以上。代價是每個執行緒一次只用一台電腦，且沒有依機器設定的權限：一次「允許存取」就交出該機器的全部檔案、程式碼和 App。
t841.en: OpenAI dots can now connect to several local computers, and you pick one per task, such as building and testing on a spare box while you code on your laptop. It is still Pro and up. The catch: each thread runs on one computer at a time, and there are no per-machine permissions, so one “Allow access” hands over that machine’s files, code and apps.
t841.ja: OpenAI dots が複数のローカルPCに接続でき、タスクごとに実行マシンを選べるようになった。予備機でビルドとテスト、ノートPCでは開発を続けるといった使い方。対象は引き続き Pro 以上。注意点は、各スレッドは同時に1台のみで、マシン単位の権限がないこと。一度「アクセスを許可」すると、そのマシンのファイル、コード、アプリすべてを渡すことになる。
t841.ko: OpenAI dots가 여러 로컬 컴퓨터에 연결되어 작업마다 실행할 기기를 고를 수 있다. 예비 기기에서 빌드·테스트하고 노트북에선 코딩을 이어가는 식이다. 여전히 Pro 이상만 해당. 단, 스레드당 한 번에 한 대만 쓰고 기기별 권한이 없어 “접근 허용” 한 번이면 그 기기의 파일, 코드, 앱 전체를 넘기게 된다.
t841.ms: OpenAI dots kini boleh bersambung ke beberapa komputer tempatan dan anda memilih satu bagi setiap tugasan, contohnya membina dan menguji pada mesin ganti sambil mengekod pada komputer riba. Masih untuk Pro ke atas. Kelemahannya: setiap utas guna satu komputer pada satu masa dan tiada kebenaran mengikut mesin, jadi satu “Allow access” menyerahkan semua fail, kod dan aplikasi mesin itu.
t841.vi: OpenAI dots giờ kết nối được nhiều máy tính cục bộ, mỗi tác vụ chọn một máy, ví dụ build và test trên máy phụ trong khi vẫn code trên laptop. Vẫn chỉ cho gói Pro trở lên. Điểm cần lưu ý: mỗi luồng chỉ chạy trên một máy một lúc và không có quyền theo từng máy, nên một lần “Allow access” là giao toàn bộ tệp, code và ứng dụng của máy đó.
t841.fr: OpenAI dots peut désormais se connecter à plusieurs ordinateurs locaux et vous choisissez celui qui exécute chaque tâche, par exemple compiler et tester sur une machine dédiée pendant que vous codez sur le portable. Réservé à Pro et au-delà. Le revers : chaque fil tourne sur un seul ordinateur à la fois et il n’existe pas de permissions par machine ; un seul « Autoriser l’accès » donne tous les fichiers, le code et les apps de la machine.
t841.es: OpenAI dots ya puede conectarse a varios ordenadores locales y eliges cuál ejecuta cada tarea, por ejemplo compilar y probar en una máquina aparte mientras programas en el portátil. Sigue siendo solo para Pro o superior. La pega: cada hilo usa un ordenador a la vez y no hay permisos por máquina, así que un solo «Permitir acceso» entrega todos los archivos, el código y las apps de esa máquina.
t841.de: OpenAI dots kann sich jetzt mit mehreren lokalen Rechnern verbinden; pro Aufgabe wählst du einen, etwa Build und Tests auf einem Zweitgerät, während du am Laptop weiterprogrammierst. Weiterhin nur ab Pro. Der Haken: Jeder Thread läuft auf einem Rechner zur Zeit, und es gibt keine Rechte pro Gerät – ein „Zugriff erlauben“ gibt alle Dateien, Code und Apps dieses Rechners frei.

t842.zh-CN: Dots 的简单自动化一天坏 5 次
t842.zh-TW: Dots 的簡單自動化一天壞 5 次
t842.en: Simple Dots automations break five times a day
t842.ja: Dots の簡単な自動化が1日5回壊れる
t842.ms: Automasi ringkas Dots rosak lima kali sehari
t842.vi: Tự động hóa đơn giản của Dots hỏng 5 lần mỗi ngày
t842.fr: Des automatisations simples de Dots cassent cinq fois par jour
t842.es: Automatizaciones simples de Dots fallan cinco veces al día
t842.de: Einfache Dots-Automationen brechen fünfmal am Tag

t843.zh-CN: 作者给了 dot 完全授权、让它主动修复，但简单的自动化仍一天坏 5 次。作者往往 12 到 48 小时后才发现，而 dot 的回复是“我告诉过你了”，那句提醒夹在 8 条无关要点中间。
t843.zh-TW: 作者給了 dot 完全授權、讓它主動修復，但簡單的自動化仍一天壞 5 次。作者常在 12 到 48 小時後才發現，而 dot 的回覆是「我告訴過你了」，那句提醒夾在 8 條無關重點中間。
t843.en: The author gave the dot full authority and permission to fix things proactively, yet simple automations break five times a day. He notices 12 to 48 hours later, and the dot replies that it told him, in the middle of eight unrelated bullet points.
t843.ja: 投稿者は dot に全権限と自発的に直す許可を与えたが、簡単な自動化が1日5回壊れる。気づくのは12〜48時間後で、dot は「伝えました」と答えるが、その知らせは無関係な8つの箇条書きの中に埋もれていた。
t843.ko: 작성자는 dot에게 전권과 선제적으로 고칠 권한을 줬지만 간단한 자동화가 하루 5번씩 고장 난다. 12~48시간 뒤에야 알아채는데, dot은 이미 말했다고 답한다. 그 알림은 관련 없는 항목 8개 사이에 묻혀 있었다.
t843.ms: Penulis memberi dot kuasa penuh dan kebenaran untuk membaiki secara proaktif, namun automasi ringkas rosak lima kali sehari. Dia hanya perasan 12 hingga 48 jam kemudian, dan dot menjawab ia sudah memberitahu, di tengah lapan poin yang tidak berkaitan.
t843.vi: Tác giả đã trao cho dot toàn quyền và cho phép chủ động sửa lỗi, nhưng các tự động hóa đơn giản vẫn hỏng 5 lần mỗi ngày. Anh chỉ phát hiện sau 12 đến 48 giờ, và dot đáp rằng nó đã báo, nằm giữa 8 gạch đầu dòng không liên quan.
t843.fr: L’auteur a donné à son dot les pleins pouvoirs et l’autorisation de corriger de lui-même, mais de simples automatisations cassent cinq fois par jour. Il s’en rend compte 12 à 48 heures plus tard, et le dot répond qu’il l’avait signalé, au milieu de huit points sans rapport.
t843.es: El autor dio a su dot plena autoridad y permiso para arreglar cosas por iniciativa propia, pero automatizaciones sencillas fallan cinco veces al día. Lo nota entre 12 y 48 horas después, y el dot responde que ya se lo dijo, en medio de ocho puntos sin relación.
t843.de: Der Autor gab seinem dot volle Befugnis und die Erlaubnis, proaktiv zu reparieren, doch einfache Automationen brechen fünfmal täglich. Er merkt es 12 bis 48 Stunden später, und der dot antwortet, er habe es gesagt – mitten in acht themenfremden Stichpunkten.

t844.zh-CN: 用了几周 Grok Bot：记忆问题让细节修改毁掉成果
t844.zh-TW: 用了幾週 Grok Bot：記憶問題讓細節修改毀掉成果
t844.en: Weeks with Grok Bot: memory problems undo finished work
t844.ja: Grok Bot を数週間使って：記憶の問題で細部の修正が成果を壊す
t844.ko: Grok Bot 몇 주 사용기: 기억 문제로 세부 수정이 결과물을 망쳐
t844.ms: Beberapa minggu dengan Grok Bot: masalah ingatan rosakkan kerja siap
t844.vi: Vài tuần với Grok Bot: lỗi trí nhớ làm hỏng phần đã xong
t844.fr: Quelques semaines avec Grok Bot : la mémoire défait le travail fini
t844.es: Semanas con Grok Bot: problemas de memoria deshacen el trabajo hecho
t844.de: Wochen mit Grok Bot: Gedächtnisprobleme machen fertige Arbeit kaputt

t845.zh-CN: 作者用 Grok Bot 数周，认为它能处理复杂操作，却在简单指令上反复出错。即便为每个 bot 建了专门的记忆文件夹，效果仍一般；做一个相对简单的应用时，它反复犯同样的错，在只剩细节调整时一改就破坏之前的工作。作者认为问题在于模型把内部假设置于明确指令之上。
t845.zh-TW: 作者用 Grok Bot 數週，認為它能處理複雜操作，卻在簡單指令上反覆出錯。即使替每個 bot 建了專屬的記憶資料夾，效果仍普通；做一個相對簡單的應用時，它反覆犯同樣的錯，在只剩細節調整時一改就破壞先前的工作。作者認為問題在於模型把內部假設置於明確指令之上。
t845.en: After several weeks, the author finds Grok Bot handles complex operations but stumbles on simple instructions. Even with a dedicated memory folder per bot, results stay mediocre; on a fairly simple app it repeats mistakes, and detail fixes on working code destroy earlier work. He argues the model puts its internal assumptions above explicit instructions.
t845.ja: 投稿者は数週間使い、Grok Bot は複雑な操作はこなすが簡単な指示で迷うと感じている。bot ごとに専用の記憶フォルダを作っても結果は平凡。比較的簡単なアプリ作りで同じ誤りを繰り返し、動いている状態で細部を直すと以前の作業を壊す。モデルが明示的な指示より内部の思い込みを優先していると指摘する。
t845.ko: 작성자는 몇 주간 써 보니 Grok Bot이 복잡한 작업은 잘하지만 간단한 지시에서 헷갈린다고 말한다. bot마다 전용 기억 폴더를 만들어도 결과는 평범했고, 비교적 간단한 앱을 만들며 같은 실수를 반복하고, 잘 돌아가는 상태에서 세부를 고치면 이전 작업을 망가뜨렸다. 모델이 명시적 지시보다 내부 가정을 우선한다고 본다.
t845.ms: Selepas beberapa minggu, penulis dapati Grok Bot boleh mengendalikan operasi kompleks tetapi keliru dengan arahan mudah. Walaupun ada folder ingatan khusus untuk setiap bot, hasilnya biasa sahaja; semasa membina aplikasi agak mudah ia mengulangi kesilapan, dan pembetulan butiran pada kod yang sudah berfungsi merosakkan kerja terdahulu. Dia berpendapat model mengutamakan andaian dalamannya berbanding arahan jelas.
t845.vi: Sau vài tuần, tác giả thấy Grok Bot xử lý tốt thao tác phức tạp nhưng lại rối với chỉ dẫn đơn giản. Dù đã làm thư mục bộ nhớ riêng cho từng bot, kết quả vẫn tầm thường; khi làm một ứng dụng khá đơn giản nó lặp lại lỗi, và sửa chi tiết trên bản đang chạy thì phá hỏng công việc trước đó. Anh cho rằng mô hình đặt giả định nội bộ lên trên chỉ dẫn rõ ràng.
t845.fr: Après plusieurs semaines, l’auteur constate que Grok Bot gère des opérations complexes mais trébuche sur des consignes simples. Même avec un dossier de mémoire dédié par bot, le résultat reste médiocre ; sur une application assez simple, il répète ses erreurs, et de petites retouches sur un code qui fonctionne détruisent le travail précédent. Selon lui, le modèle fait passer ses suppositions internes avant les consignes explicites.
t845.es: Tras varias semanas, el autor ve que Grok Bot maneja operaciones complejas pero se confunde con instrucciones simples. Aun con una carpeta de memoria dedicada por bot, el resultado es mediocre; en una aplicación bastante sencilla repite errores, y los ajustes de detalle sobre código que ya funciona destruyen el trabajo previo. Sostiene que el modelo antepone sus supuestos internos a las instrucciones explícitas.
t845.de: Nach einigen Wochen stellt der Autor fest, dass Grok Bot komplexe Abläufe schafft, aber an einfachen Anweisungen scheitert. Trotz eigener Gedächtnisordner pro Bot bleibt das Ergebnis mittelmäßig; bei einer recht einfachen App wiederholt er Fehler, und Detailkorrekturen an funktionierendem Code zerstören frühere Arbeit. Er meint, das Modell stelle interne Annahmen über klare Anweisungen.

t846.zh-CN: 一个人，一整支 Meta Muse 教练团队
t846.zh-TW: 一個人，一整支 Meta Muse 教練團隊
t846.en: One person, a full coaching staff on Meta Muse
t846.ja: 一人で Meta Muse のコーチングスタッフ一式を運用
t846.ko: 혼자서 Meta Muse로 코칭 스태프 전체를 운영
t846.ms: Seorang diri, satu pasukan kejurulatihan penuh dengan Meta Muse
t846.vi: Một người, cả một ban huấn luyện chạy trên Meta Muse
t846.fr: Seul, mais avec tout un staff d’entraîneurs sur Meta Muse
t846.es: Una sola persona con todo un cuerpo técnico en Meta Muse
t846.de: Eine Person, ein ganzer Trainerstab auf Meta Muse

t847.zh-CN: 作者用 Meta Muse 搭了一支在家中电脑上全天运行的“教练团队”：幕僚长、工程师、球探、会计、排程员，还有二十多个岗位。这是其“使用 AI 助手”系列的第 3 篇。
t847.zh-TW: 作者用 Meta Muse 搭了一支在家中電腦上全天運行的「教練團隊」：幕僚長、工程師、球探、會計、排程員，還有二十多個職位。這是其「使用 AI 助手」系列的第 3 篇。
t847.en: The author built a “coaching staff” on Meta Muse running around the clock on computers at home: chief of staff, engineer, scout, accountant, scheduler and twenty more seats. It is post 3 of his Using AI Assistants series.
t847.ja: 投稿者は Meta Muse で、自宅のPC上で24時間動く「コーチングスタッフ」を構築。チーフ・オブ・スタッフ、エンジニア、スカウト、会計、スケジューラー、さらに20以上の役割がある。連載「AI アシスタントの使い方」第3回。
t847.ko: 작성자는 Meta Muse로 집 컴퓨터에서 24시간 돌아가는 “코칭 스태프”를 만들었다. 비서실장, 엔지니어, 스카우트, 회계, 일정 담당, 그리고 20개가 넘는 자리가 있다. “AI 비서 활용” 시리즈 3편이다.
t847.ms: Penulis membina “pasukan kejurulatihan” dengan Meta Muse yang berjalan sepanjang masa pada komputer di rumah: ketua staf, jurutera, peninjau, akauntan, penjadual dan lebih dua puluh peranan lagi. Ini hantaran ke-3 siri Using AI Assistants.
t847.vi: Tác giả dựng một “ban huấn luyện” bằng Meta Muse chạy suốt ngày đêm trên các máy tính tại nhà: chánh văn phòng, kỹ sư, tuyển trạch viên, kế toán, người xếp lịch và hơn hai mươi vị trí khác. Đây là bài thứ 3 trong loạt Using AI Assistants.
t847.fr: L’auteur a monté sur Meta Muse un « staff » qui tourne jour et nuit sur des ordinateurs chez lui : chef de cabinet, ingénieur, recruteur, comptable, planificateur et plus de vingt autres postes. C’est le 3e billet de sa série Using AI Assistants.
t847.es: El autor montó en Meta Muse un «cuerpo técnico» que funciona día y noche en ordenadores de su casa: jefe de gabinete, ingeniero, ojeador, contable, planificador y más de veinte puestos. Es la 3.ª entrega de su serie Using AI Assistants.
t847.de: Der Autor baute mit Meta Muse einen „Trainerstab“, der rund um die Uhr auf Rechnern bei ihm zu Hause läuft: Stabschef, Ingenieur, Scout, Buchhalter, Terminplaner und über zwanzig weitere Rollen. Teil 3 seiner Reihe Using AI Assistants.

t848.zh-CN: 实测：OpenAI Dots 直接访问本地 Codex 对话并操控电脑
t848.zh-TW: 實測：OpenAI Dots 直接存取本地 Codex 對話並操控電腦
t848.en: Tested: OpenAI Dots now reaches local Codex chats and uses the computer
t848.ja: 検証：OpenAI Dots がローカルの Codex チャットとPC操作に対応
t848.ko: 실험: OpenAI Dots가 로컬 Codex 채팅과 컴퓨터 제어에 직접 접근
t848.ms: Diuji: OpenAI Dots kini capai sembang Codex tempatan dan guna komputer
t848.vi: Thử nghiệm: OpenAI Dots truy cập trực tiếp chat Codex cục bộ và điều khiển máy
t848.fr: Test : OpenAI Dots accède aux chats Codex locaux et pilote l'ordinateur
t848.es: Probado: OpenAI Dots ya accede a chats locales de Codex y usa el ordenador
t848.de: Getestet: OpenAI Dots greift auf lokale Codex-Chats zu und bedient den Rechner

t849.zh-CN: 作者在早前视频的续集里，用自己的 Dot 测试修复后的本地访问：在 Mac 和通过 SSH 连接的远程开发机上创建、置顶、重命名 Codex 对话并发消息，讲解 multi-exec 更新的影响，再用 Apple Notes 和 Chrome 测试直接操控电脑，并展示遇到的权限提示。
t849.zh-TW: 作者在早前影片的續集裡，用自己的 Dot 測試修復後的本地存取：在 Mac 和透過 SSH 連線的遠端開發機上建立、置頂、重新命名 Codex 對話並傳訊息，說明 multi-exec 更新的影響，再用 Apple Notes 和 Chrome 測試直接操控電腦，並展示遇到的權限提示。
t849.en: In a follow-up to earlier videos, the author tests the local access fix with his Dot: creating, pinning, renaming and messaging Codex chats on his Mac and on a remote dev box over SSH, explaining what the multi-exec update changes, then trying direct computer use with Apple Notes and Chrome, including the permission prompt he hit.
t849.ja: 以前の動画の続編として、投稿者は自分の Dot で修正後のローカルアクセスを検証。Mac と SSH 経由のリモート開発機で Codex チャットの作成、ピン留め、名前変更、メッセージ送信を行い、multi-exec アップデートの影響を説明し、Apple Notes と Chrome で直接のPC操作も試し、表示された権限プロンプトも紹介する。
t849.ko: 이전 영상의 후속편에서 작성자는 자신의 Dot으로 수정된 로컬 접근을 시험한다. Mac과 SSH로 연결한 원격 개발 서버에서 Codex 채팅을 만들고 고정하고 이름을 바꾸고 메시지를 보내며, multi-exec 업데이트가 무엇을 바꾸는지 설명하고, Apple Notes와 Chrome으로 직접 컴퓨터 사용을 시험하면서 마주친 권한 요청도 보여준다.
t849.ms: Dalam sambungan video terdahulu, penulis menguji pembaikan akses tempatan dengan Dot miliknya: mencipta, menyemat, menamakan semula dan menghantar mesej dalam sembang Codex pada Mac dan pelayan pembangunan jauh melalui SSH, menerangkan kesan kemas kini multi-exec, kemudian mencuba penggunaan komputer secara terus dengan Apple Notes dan Chrome, termasuk gesaan kebenaran yang ditemuinya.
t849.vi: Trong phần tiếp theo các video trước, tác giả thử bản sửa truy cập cục bộ với Dot của mình: tạo, ghim, đổi tên và nhắn tin trong các chat Codex trên Mac và máy dev từ xa qua SSH, giải thích bản cập nhật multi-exec thay đổi gì, rồi thử điều khiển máy trực tiếp với Apple Notes và Chrome, kể cả lời nhắc cấp quyền gặp phải.
t849.fr: Dans la suite de ses vidéos, l'auteur teste avec son Dot le correctif d'accès local : créer, épingler, renommer et envoyer des messages dans des chats Codex sur son Mac et sur une machine de dev distante via SSH, explique ce que change la mise à jour multi-exec, puis essaie le pilotage direct d'Apple Notes et de Chrome, invite d'autorisation comprise.
t849.es: En la continuación de vídeos anteriores, el autor prueba con su Dot el arreglo de acceso local: crear, fijar, renombrar y enviar mensajes en chats de Codex en su Mac y en una máquina de desarrollo remota por SSH, explica qué cambia la actualización multi-exec y prueba el uso directo del ordenador con Apple Notes y Chrome, incluido el aviso de permisos que le apareció.
t849.de: In der Fortsetzung früherer Videos testet der Autor mit seinem Dot den Fix für lokalen Zugriff: Codex-Chats auf dem Mac und auf einer entfernten Dev-Maschine per SSH anlegen, anpinnen, umbenennen und anschreiben, die Auswirkungen des Multi-Exec-Updates erklären und dann direkte Computersteuerung mit Apple Notes und Chrome ausprobieren, samt der aufgetauchten Berechtigungsabfrage.

t850.zh-CN: 把付费群聊里的干货交给 Grok Bot 按主题整理
t850.zh-TW: 把付費群聊裡的乾貨交給 Grok Bot 按主題整理
t850.en: Handing paid group-chat knowledge to Grok Bot to sort by topic
t850.ja: 有料グループの有益な投稿をGrok Botでテーマ別に整理
t850.ko: 유료 단톡방의 유용한 내용을 Grok Bot으로 주제별 정리
t850.ms: Menyerahkan isi kumpulan sembang berbayar kepada Grok Bot untuk disusun ikut topik
t850.vi: Giao kiến thức trong các nhóm chat trả phí cho Grok Bot sắp xếp theo chủ đề
t850.fr: Confier à Grok Bot le tri par thème des groupes de discussion payants
t850.es: Pasar a Grok Bot lo útil de los chats de pago para ordenarlo por tema
t850.de: Wissen aus bezahlten Gruppenchats von Grok Bot nach Themen ordnen lassen

t851.zh-CN: 作者买了很多付费群，有用内容埋在聊天记录里。做法是挑出值得整理的讨论，连同附件发给 Grok Bot，让它按主题归类，提取工具、方法和没解决的问题，以后找资源不用再凭记忆翻群。
t851.zh-TW: 作者買了很多付費群，有用內容埋在聊天紀錄裡。做法是挑出值得整理的討論，連同附件傳給 Grok Bot，讓它按主題歸類，擷取工具、方法和沒解決的問題，以後找資源不必再憑記憶翻群。
t851.en: The author has joined many paid groups whose useful content is buried in chat history. They pick the discussions worth keeping, send them with attachments to Grok Bot, and have it group them by topic and pull out tools, methods and open questions, so a resource can be found later without relying on memory.
t851.ja: 作者は多くの有料グループに入っているが、有益な内容はチャット履歴に埋もれていた。整理する価値のある議論を添付ファイルごとGrok Botに送り、テーマ別に分類してツール、手法、未解決の問題を抽出させる。後で資料を探すときに記憶に頼らずに済む。
t851.ko: 작성자는 유료 그룹에 많이 가입했지만 유용한 내용이 대화 기록에 묻혀 있었다. 정리할 만한 대화를 첨부파일과 함께 Grok Bot에 보내 주제별로 분류하고 도구, 방법, 해결되지 않은 질문을 뽑아내게 한다. 나중에 자료를 찾을 때 기억에 의존하지 않아도 된다.
t851.ms: Penulis menyertai banyak kumpulan berbayar dan kandungan berguna tertimbus dalam sejarah sembang. Dia memilih perbincangan yang patut disimpan, menghantarnya bersama lampiran kepada Grok Bot, dan meminta ia menyusun ikut topik serta mengeluarkan alat, kaedah dan soalan yang belum selesai.
t851.vi: Tác giả tham gia nhiều nhóm trả phí nhưng nội dung hữu ích bị chìm trong lịch sử chat. Họ chọn các thảo luận đáng giữ, gửi kèm tệp đính kèm cho Grok Bot để phân loại theo chủ đề và rút ra công cụ, phương pháp và các câu hỏi chưa giải quyết.
t851.fr: L'auteur suit de nombreux groupes payants dont le contenu utile se perd dans l'historique. Il choisit les discussions à garder, les envoie avec leurs pièces jointes à Grok Bot, qui les classe par thème et en extrait outils, méthodes et questions non résolues.
t851.es: El autor está en muchos grupos de pago y lo útil queda enterrado en el historial. Elige las conversaciones que vale la pena guardar, las envía con sus adjuntos a Grok Bot y le pide clasificarlas por tema y extraer herramientas, métodos y preguntas sin resolver.
t851.de: Der Autor ist in vielen bezahlten Gruppen, deren nützliche Inhalte im Chatverlauf untergehen. Er wählt lohnende Diskussionen aus, schickt sie samt Anhängen an Grok Bot und lässt sie nach Themen sortieren sowie Tools, Methoden und offene Fragen herausziehen.

t852.zh-CN: Grok Bot 报内存不足，原因是云主机的内存气球
t852.zh-TW: Grok Bot 回報記憶體不足，原因是雲端主機的記憶體氣球
t852.en: Grok Bot's low-memory warning came from a memory balloon
t852.ja: Grok Botのメモリ不足表示はメモリバルーンが原因
t852.ko: Grok Bot 메모리 부족 경고의 원인은 메모리 벌룬
t852.ms: Amaran memori rendah Grok Bot berpunca daripada memory balloon
t852.vi: Cảnh báo thiếu bộ nhớ của Grok Bot do cơ chế memory balloon
t852.fr: L'alerte mémoire de Grok Bot venait d'un ballon mémoire
t852.es: La alerta de poca memoria de Grok Bot venía de un balón de memoria
t852.de: Grok Bots Speicherwarnung kam von einem Memory Balloon

t853.zh-CN: 作者的 Grok Bot 提示内存只剩约 2 GB（共 15.6 GB），但并不是传统的内存泄漏。它的云主机使用内存气球机制：电脑空闲时会收缩分配给它的内存，让平台把内存挪给别处使用。
t853.zh-TW: 作者的 Grok Bot 提示記憶體只剩約 2 GB（共 15.6 GB），但並不是傳統的記憶體洩漏。它的雲端主機使用記憶體氣球機制：電腦閒置時會縮小分配給它的記憶體，讓平台把記憶體挪給別處使用。
t853.en: The author's Grok Bot reported about 2 GB free out of 15.6 GB, yet there was no traditional memory leak. Its cloud host uses a memory balloon, which shrinks the RAM a computer gets while idle so the platform can use it elsewhere.
t853.ja: 作者のGrok Botは15.6 GB中約2 GBしか空きがないと報告したが、従来型のメモリリークではなかった。クラウドホストはメモリバルーンを使っており、アイドル中のコンピューターに割り当てるRAMを縮小して他で使えるようにしている。
t853.ko: 작성자의 Grok Bot이 15.6 GB 중 약 2 GB만 남았다고 했지만 전통적인 메모리 누수는 아니었다. 클라우드 호스트가 메모리 벌룬을 사용해 컴퓨터가 유휴 상태일 때 할당된 RAM을 줄이고 다른 곳에 쓰기 때문이다.
t853.ms: Grok Bot penulis melaporkan kira-kira 2 GB kosong daripada 15.6 GB, namun tiada kebocoran memori biasa. Hos awannya menggunakan memory balloon yang mengecilkan RAM komputer ketika melahu supaya platform boleh menggunakannya di tempat lain.
t853.vi: Grok Bot của tác giả báo chỉ còn khoảng 2 GB trống trên 15.6 GB, nhưng không phải rò rỉ bộ nhớ thông thường. Máy chủ đám mây dùng memory balloon, thu nhỏ RAM cấp cho máy khi nhàn rỗi để nền tảng dùng ở nơi khác.
t853.fr: Le Grok Bot de l'auteur signalait environ 2 Go libres sur 15,6 Go, sans fuite de mémoire classique. Son hôte cloud utilise un ballon mémoire qui réduit la RAM d'un ordinateur inactif pour que la plateforme l'utilise ailleurs.
t853.es: El Grok Bot del autor indicaba unos 2 GB libres de 15,6 GB, pero no había una fuga de memoria clásica. Su host en la nube usa un balón de memoria que reduce la RAM de un equipo inactivo para que la plataforma la use en otro sitio.
t853.de: Der Grok Bot des Autors meldete etwa 2 GB frei von 15,6 GB, ohne klassisches Speicherleck. Der Cloud-Host nutzt einen Memory Balloon, der den RAM eines untätigen Rechners verkleinert, damit die Plattform ihn anderswo nutzen kann.

t857.zh-CN: 作者让 Grok Bot 每天（包括周末）运行，产出在 Google Colab 上跑开源模型的笔记本，全部在 15GB 显存的 T4 GPU 上运行。作者称这是自己最接近软件工厂的一次，并公开了它做出的笔记本。
t857.zh-TW: 作者讓 Grok Bot 每天（包括週末）運行，產出在 Google Colab 上跑開源模型的筆記本，全部在 15GB 顯示記憶體的 T4 GPU 上運行。作者稱這是自己最接近軟體工廠的一次，並公開了它做出的筆記本。
t857.en: The author runs Grok Bot every day, weekends included, to produce Google Colab notebooks that run open models, all on a T4 GPU with 15GB VRAM. They call it the closest they've come to a software factory and share the notebooks it built for free.
t857.ja: 作者はGrok Botを週末も含め毎日動かし、オープンモデルを動かすGoogle Colabノートブックを作らせている。すべて15GB VRAMのT4 GPUで動作する。ソフトウェア工場に最も近いと述べ、作られたノートブックを無料公開している。
t857.ko: 작성자는 주말을 포함해 매일 Grok Bot을 돌려 오픈 모델을 실행하는 Google Colab 노트북을 만들게 한다. 모두 15GB VRAM의 T4 GPU에서 돌아간다. 소프트웨어 공장에 가장 가까워졌다고 하며 만든 노트북을 무료로 공개했다.
t857.ms: Penulis menjalankan Grok Bot setiap hari, termasuk hujung minggu, untuk menghasilkan buku nota Google Colab yang menjalankan model terbuka, semuanya pada GPU T4 dengan VRAM 15GB. Dia menyifatkannya paling hampir dengan kilang perisian dan berkongsi buku nota itu secara percuma.
t857.vi: Tác giả cho Grok Bot chạy mỗi ngày, kể cả cuối tuần, để tạo notebook Google Colab chạy các mô hình mở, tất cả trên GPU T4 15GB VRAM. Họ gọi đây là lần gần nhất với một nhà máy phần mềm và chia sẻ miễn phí các notebook.
t857.fr: L'auteur fait tourner Grok Bot tous les jours, week-ends compris, pour produire des notebooks Google Colab exécutant des modèles ouverts, tous sur un GPU T4 de 15 Go de VRAM. Il y voit ce qui s'approche le plus d'une usine logicielle et partage les notebooks gratuitement.
t857.es: El autor ejecuta Grok Bot a diario, incluidos los fines de semana, para crear notebooks de Google Colab que ejecutan modelos abiertos, todos en una GPU T4 de 15 GB de VRAM. Dice que es lo más parecido a una fábrica de software y comparte gratis los notebooks.
t857.de: Der Autor lässt Grok Bot jeden Tag, auch am Wochenende, Google-Colab-Notebooks erstellen, die offene Modelle ausführen, alle auf einer T4-GPU mit 15 GB VRAM. Er nennt es das Nächste an einer Softwarefabrik und teilt die Notebooks kostenlos.

t859.zh-TW: 作者列出小企業可建置的六條 Grok Bot 業務線：調研與策略、銷售管線、會議營運、客戶支援、財務與報表、行銷規劃。每條線中間都有同一條規則：逐項核准具體動作。
t859.en: The author lists six Grok Bot lanes for a small business: research and strategy, sales pipeline, meeting operations, customer support, finance and reporting, and marketing planning. Every lane shares one rule in the middle: approve the exact action.
t859.ja: 作者は小規模企業向けに6つのGrok Botレーンを挙げる。リサーチと戦略、営業パイプライン、会議運営、カスタマーサポート、財務とレポート、マーケティング計画。どのレーンにも共通のルールがあり、具体的な操作をその都度承認する。
t859.ko: 작성자는 소규모 사업체용 Grok Bot 라인 6가지를 제시한다. 리서치와 전략, 영업 파이프라인, 회의 운영, 고객 지원, 재무와 보고, 마케팅 기획. 모든 라인에 공통 규칙이 하나 있는데, 정확한 작업을 승인하는 것이다.
t859.ms: Penulis menyenaraikan enam laluan Grok Bot untuk perniagaan kecil: penyelidikan dan strategi, saluran jualan, operasi mesyuarat, sokongan pelanggan, kewangan dan laporan, serta perancangan pemasaran. Setiap laluan berkongsi satu peraturan: luluskan tindakan yang tepat.
t859.vi: Tác giả liệt kê sáu mảng Grok Bot cho doanh nghiệp nhỏ: nghiên cứu và chiến lược, quy trình bán hàng, vận hành cuộc họp, hỗ trợ khách hàng, tài chính và báo cáo, lập kế hoạch marketing. Mảng nào cũng chung một quy tắc: duyệt đúng từng hành động.
t859.fr: L'auteur liste six chantiers Grok Bot pour une petite entreprise : recherche et stratégie, pipeline commercial, gestion des réunions, support client, finance et reporting, planification marketing. Chacun suit une règle commune : approuver l'action exacte.
t859.es: El autor enumera seis líneas de Grok Bot para una pequeña empresa: investigación y estrategia, embudo de ventas, operaciones de reuniones, atención al cliente, finanzas e informes, y planificación de marketing. Todas comparten una regla: aprobar la acción exacta.
t859.de: Der Autor nennt sechs Grok-Bot-Bereiche für kleine Firmen: Recherche und Strategie, Vertriebspipeline, Meeting-Organisation, Kundensupport, Finanzen und Reporting sowie Marketingplanung. Für alle gilt eine Regel: die genaue Aktion freigeben.

t861.zh-TW: 作者把一張 1975 年 AMC Pacer 的平面照片變成可環繞查看的 3D 場景，在 CPU 上用時 87 秒，成本 0 美元。Grok Bot 做了深度圖、網格、檢視器和循環 GIF。作者在文中給出具體提示詞、修復過程、程式碼倉庫以及擴展到 360 度整車的方法。

t863.zh-CN: 马斯克同时经营 X、SpaceX、Tesla、Neuralink、The Boring Company 和 Terafab，并整天发帖，跟进这些成了全职工作。作者因此做了一个名为 Muskverse 的 Grok Bot 来盯这些动态，只告诉他真正重要的内容。

t863.en: Elon runs X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company and Terafab and posts about all of them all day, so keeping up became a full-time job. The author handed it to a Grok Bot called Muskverse that tells them only what matters.
t863.ja: イーロンはX、SpaceX、Tesla、Neuralink、The Boring Company、Terafabを率い、一日中それらについて投稿している。追いかけるのがフルタイムの仕事になったため、作者はMuskverseというGrok Botに任せ、重要なことだけ知らせるようにした。
t863.ko: 일론은 X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company, Terafab을 운영하며 하루 종일 이에 대해 글을 올린다. 따라가는 일이 풀타임 업무가 되자 작성자는 Muskverse라는 Grok Bot에 맡겨 중요한 것만 전달받는다.
t863.ms: Elon menguruskan X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company dan Terafab serta menyiarkan tentangnya sepanjang hari, jadi mengikutinya menjadi kerja sepenuh masa. Penulis menyerahkannya kepada Grok Bot bernama Muskverse yang hanya memberitahu perkara penting.
t863.vi: Elon điều hành X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company và Terafab, đăng bài về tất cả cả ngày, nên theo kịp trở thành việc toàn thời gian. Tác giả giao việc này cho một Grok Bot tên Muskverse chỉ báo những gì quan trọng.
t863.fr: Elon dirige X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company et Terafab et publie sur tout cela à longueur de journée ; suivre devenait un travail à plein temps. L'auteur l'a confié à un Grok Bot nommé Muskverse qui ne lui remonte que l'essentiel.
t863.es: Elon dirige X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company y Terafab y publica sobre todo ello todo el día, así que seguirlo era un trabajo a tiempo completo. El autor se lo encargó a un Grok Bot llamado Muskverse que solo le cuenta lo importante.
t863.de: Elon leitet X, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company und Terafab und postet den ganzen Tag darüber; Schritt zu halten wurde ein Vollzeitjob. Der Autor übergab das an einen Grok Bot namens Muskverse, der nur meldet, was zählt.

t864.de: Chase, der Meta-Muse-Agent einer Schuhladeninhaberin, und seine Freigaberegel

t865.zh-CN: 据 11 月 3 日 Creators Syndicate 专栏，俄亥俄州哥伦布的 JaeLuxe Shoetique 店主 April Polk 先上传两页品牌指南，代理审查账户后返回更长的指南，又审计邮件流程并重做模板。她仍审核每次修改，任何发布、发送或花钱都要她批准。作者据此总结了五条做法。
t865.zh-TW: 據 11 月 3 日 Creators Syndicate 專欄，俄亥俄州哥倫布的 JaeLuxe Shoetique 店主 April Polk 先上傳兩頁品牌指南，代理審查帳戶後回傳更長的指南，又稽核郵件流程並重做範本。她仍審核每次修改，任何發布、寄送或花錢都要她核准。作者據此整理了五條做法。
t865.en: Per a Nov 3 Creators Syndicate column, April Polk of JaeLuxe Shoetique near Columbus, Ohio uploaded a two-page brand guide; her agent reviewed her accounts, returned a longer guide, audited email flows and rebuilt templates. She still reviews its work, and nothing publishes, sends or spends without her approval. The author turns this into five steps.
t865.ja: 11月3日のCreators Syndicateのコラムによると、オハイオ州コロンバス近郊のJaeLuxe ShoetiqueのApril Polkは2ページのブランドガイドを先にアップロードした。エージェントはアカウントを確認してより長いガイドを返し、メールフローを監査してテンプレートを作り直した。彼女は今も作業を確認し、公開・送信・支出は承認なしに行われない。作者はこれを5つの手順にまとめている。
t865.ko: 11월 3일 Creators Syndicate 칼럼에 따르면 오하이오주 콜럼버스 인근 JaeLuxe Shoetique의 April Polk는 두 쪽짜리 브랜드 가이드를 먼저 올렸다. 에이전트는 계정을 검토해 더 긴 가이드를 돌려주고 이메일 흐름을 점검해 템플릿을 다시 만들었다. 그녀는 여전히 작업을 검토하며 승인 없이는 게시, 발송, 지출이 없다. 작성자는 이를 다섯 단계로 정리했다.
t865.ms: Menurut kolum Creators Syndicate 3 Nov, April Polk dari JaeLuxe Shoetique berhampiran Columbus, Ohio memuat naik panduan jenama dua halaman; ejennya menyemak akaun, memulangkan panduan lebih panjang, mengaudit aliran e-mel dan membina semula templat. Dia masih menyemak kerjanya dan tiada apa diterbitkan, dihantar atau dibelanjakan tanpa kelulusannya.
t865.vi: Theo chuyên mục Creators Syndicate ngày 3/11, April Polk của JaeLuxe Shoetique gần Columbus, Ohio tải lên bản hướng dẫn thương hiệu hai trang; agent rà soát tài khoản, trả về bản hướng dẫn dài hơn, kiểm tra luồng email và làm lại mẫu. Cô vẫn duyệt công việc và không gì được đăng, gửi hay chi tiền nếu chưa được cô đồng ý.
t865.fr: Selon une chronique Creators Syndicate du 3 novembre, April Polk (JaeLuxe Shoetique, près de Columbus, Ohio) a d'abord fourni un guide de marque de deux pages ; l'agent a examiné ses comptes, rendu un guide plus long, audité les flux d'e-mails et refait les modèles. Elle relit toujours son travail et rien n'est publié, envoyé ni dépensé sans son accord.
t865.es: Según una columna de Creators Syndicate del 3 de noviembre, April Polk, de JaeLuxe Shoetique cerca de Columbus (Ohio), subió primero una guía de marca de dos páginas; el agente revisó sus cuentas, devolvió una guía más larga, auditó los flujos de correo y rehízo las plantillas. Ella sigue revisando y nada se publica, envía ni gasta sin su aprobación.
t865.de: Laut einer Creators-Syndicate-Kolumne vom 3. November lud April Polk von JaeLuxe Shoetique bei Columbus, Ohio, zuerst einen zweiseitigen Markenleitfaden hoch; der Agent prüfte ihre Konten, lieferte einen längeren Leitfaden, prüfte E-Mail-Abläufe und baute Vorlagen neu. Sie prüft weiterhin alles, und nichts wird ohne ihre Freigabe veröffentlicht, gesendet oder bezahlt.

t866.zh-CN: Meta Muse 把凌乱的举重笔记做成 Space
t866.zh-TW: Meta Muse 把凌亂的舉重筆記做成 Space
t866.en: Meta Muse turns messy weightlifting notes into a Space
t866.ja: Meta Museが散らかった筋トレメモをSpaceに
t866.ko: Meta Muse가 엉망인 웨이트 메모를 Space로
t866.ms: Meta Muse menukar nota angkat berat yang bersepah menjadi Space
t866.vi: Meta Muse biến ghi chú tập tạ lộn xộn thành một Space
t866.fr: Meta Muse transforme des notes de musculation en Space
t866.es: Meta Muse convierte notas de pesas desordenadas en un Space
t866.de: Meta Muse macht aus chaotischen Krafttraining-Notizen einen Space

t867.zh-CN: 作者的举重笔记一团乱，他的 Meta Muse 助手 Nova 把它们做成了一个 Muse Space，带复选框，还有一个在重量变轻松时用来加重的按钮。
t867.zh-TW: 作者的舉重筆記一團亂，他的 Meta Muse 助手 Nova 把它們做成了一個 Muse Space，帶核取方塊，還有一個在重量變輕鬆時用來加重的按鈕。
t867.en: The author's weightlifting notes were a mess. His Meta Muse assistant Nova turned them into a Muse Space with checkboxes and a bump button for when a weight gets too easy.
t867.ja: 作者の筋トレメモはぐちゃぐちゃだった。Meta MuseのアシスタントNovaがそれをMuse Spaceにまとめ、チェックボックスと、重量が楽になったときに増やすボタンを付けた。
t867.ko: 작성자의 웨이트 트레이닝 메모는 엉망이었다. Meta Muse 어시스턴트 Nova가 이를 체크박스와 무게가 쉬워지면 올리는 버튼이 있는 Muse Space로 만들었다.
t867.ms: Nota angkat berat penulis berselerak. Pembantu Meta Muse beliau, Nova, menukarnya menjadi Muse Space dengan kotak semak dan butang untuk menaikkan berat apabila terlalu mudah.
t867.vi: Ghi chú tập tạ của tác giả rất lộn xộn. Trợ lý Meta Muse tên Nova đã biến chúng thành một Muse Space có ô đánh dấu và nút tăng mức tạ khi thấy quá nhẹ.
t867.fr: Les notes de musculation de l'auteur étaient en désordre. Son assistant Meta Muse, Nova, en a fait un Muse Space avec des cases à cocher et un bouton pour augmenter la charge quand elle devient trop facile.
t867.es: Las notas de levantamiento de pesas del autor eran un caos. Su asistente de Meta Muse, Nova, las convirtió en un Muse Space con casillas y un botón para subir el peso cuando resulta demasiado fácil.
t867.de: Die Krafttraining-Notizen des Autors waren chaotisch. Sein Meta-Muse-Assistent Nova machte daraus einen Muse Space mit Checkboxen und einem Knopf zum Erhöhen, wenn ein Gewicht zu leicht wird.

t868.zh-CN: AgentMsgr：给 Meta Muse 加上多机器人和群聊的界面
t868.zh-TW: AgentMsgr：替 Meta Muse 加上多機器人和群聊的介面
t868.en: AgentMsgr: a UI that gives Meta Muse multiple bots and group chats
t868.ja: AgentMsgr：Meta Museに複数ボットとグループチャットを加えるUI
t868.ko: AgentMsgr: Meta Muse에 다중 봇과 그룹 채팅을 더하는 UI
t868.ms: AgentMsgr: UI yang memberi Meta Muse berbilang bot dan sembang kumpulan
t868.vi: AgentMsgr: giao diện cho Meta Muse nhiều bot và chat nhóm
t868.fr: AgentMsgr : une interface multi-bots et discussions de groupe pour Meta Muse
t868.es: AgentMsgr: una interfaz con varios bots y chats de grupo para Meta Muse
t868.de: AgentMsgr: eine Oberfläche mit mehreren Bots und Gruppenchats für Meta Muse

t869.zh-CN: AgentMsgr 团队为 Meta Muse 做了一个界面，提供多机器人能力和群聊。团队内部一直在用，它也适用于其他云端托管的代理，但设计时以 Muse 为主。附有简短说明视频。
t869.zh-TW: AgentMsgr 團隊為 Meta Muse 做了一個介面，提供多機器人能力和群聊。團隊內部一直在用，它也適用於其他雲端託管的代理，但設計時以 Muse 為主。附有簡短說明影片。
t869.en: The AgentMsgr team built a UI for Meta Muse that adds multiple-bot capability and group chats. The team uses it internally, and it also works for other cloud-hosted agents, though it was built with Muse in mind. A short explainer video is attached.
t869.ja: AgentMsgrチームはMeta Muse向けに、複数ボット機能とグループチャットを加えるUIを作った。チーム内で使っており、他のクラウドホスト型エージェントでも動くが、Museを前提に作られている。短い説明動画付き。
t869.ko: AgentMsgr 팀은 Meta Muse에 다중 봇 기능과 그룹 채팅을 더하는 UI를 만들었다. 팀 내부에서 쓰고 있으며 다른 클라우드 호스팅 에이전트에서도 작동하지만 Muse를 염두에 두고 만들었다. 짧은 설명 영상이 있다.
t869.ms: Pasukan AgentMsgr membina UI untuk Meta Muse yang menambah keupayaan berbilang bot dan sembang kumpulan. Pasukan menggunakannya secara dalaman dan ia juga berfungsi untuk ejen awan lain, walaupun dibina dengan Muse dalam fikiran.
t869.vi: Nhóm AgentMsgr xây giao diện cho Meta Muse, bổ sung khả năng nhiều bot và chat nhóm. Nhóm dùng nội bộ, và nó cũng chạy với các agent đám mây khác, dù được làm với Muse làm trọng tâm. Có video giải thích ngắn.
t869.fr: L'équipe AgentMsgr a créé une interface pour Meta Muse qui ajoute plusieurs bots et des discussions de groupe. Elle l'utilise en interne ; l'outil fonctionne aussi avec d'autres agents hébergés dans le cloud, mais a été conçu pour Muse.
t869.es: El equipo de AgentMsgr creó una interfaz para Meta Muse que añade varios bots y chats de grupo. La usan internamente y también funciona con otros agentes alojados en la nube, aunque se pensó para Muse.
t869.de: Das AgentMsgr-Team baute eine Oberfläche für Meta Muse mit mehreren Bots und Gruppenchats. Das Team nutzt sie intern; sie funktioniert auch mit anderen Cloud-Agenten, wurde aber für Muse entworfen.

t870.zh-CN: 按任务整理的 26 个 Grok Bot 用例目录
t870.zh-TW: 按任務整理的 26 個 Grok Bot 用例目錄
t870.en: 26 Grok Bot use cases sorted by task
t870.ja: タスク別に整理した26のGrok Botユースケース
t870.ko: 작업별로 정리한 Grok Bot 사용 사례 26가지
t870.ms: 26 kes penggunaan Grok Bot disusun ikut tugas
t870.vi: 26 trường hợp dùng Grok Bot xếp theo công việc
t870.fr: 26 cas d'usage de Grok Bot classés par tâche
t870.es: 26 casos de uso de Grok Bot ordenados por tarea

t871.zh-CN: 作者把自己目录里的 26 个 Grok Bot 用例按任务分类：收件箱分拣、潜在客户简报、价格监控、投资人更新、催收发票和机器人维护。每个用例都链接到完整提示词，并注明分享者。
t871.zh-TW: 作者把自己目錄裡的 26 個 Grok Bot 用例按任務分類：收件匣分揀、潛在客戶簡報、價格監控、投資人更新、催收發票和機器人維護。每個用例都連到完整提示詞，並註明分享者。
t871.en: The author sorted 26 Grok Bot use cases from their directory by task: inbox triage, lead briefs, price watch, investor updates, invoice chasing and bot upkeep. Each one links to the full prompt, with credit to whoever shared it.
t871.ja: 作者は自分のディレクトリにある26のGrok Botユースケースをタスク別に分類した。受信箱の仕分け、見込み客ブリーフ、価格監視、投資家向け報告、請求書の督促、ボットのメンテナンス。各ケースに完全なプロンプトへのリンクと共有者のクレジットがある。
t871.ko: 작성자는 디렉터리의 Grok Bot 사용 사례 26개를 작업별로 분류했다. 받은편지함 분류, 리드 브리핑, 가격 감시, 투자자 업데이트, 청구서 독촉, 봇 관리. 각 사례는 전체 프롬프트로 연결되며 공유한 사람을 밝혀 두었다.
t871.ms: Penulis menyusun 26 kes penggunaan Grok Bot daripada direktorinya ikut tugas: susun peti masuk, taklimat prospek, pantau harga, kemas kini pelabur, kejar invois dan penyelenggaraan bot. Setiap satu dipautkan ke prompt penuh dengan kredit kepada pengongsinya.
t871.vi: Tác giả xếp 26 trường hợp dùng Grok Bot trong thư mục của mình theo công việc: lọc hộp thư, tóm tắt khách tiềm năng, theo dõi giá, cập nhật nhà đầu tư, đòi hóa đơn và bảo trì bot. Mỗi mục dẫn đến prompt đầy đủ, ghi công người chia sẻ.
t871.fr: L'auteur a classé par tâche 26 cas d'usage de Grok Bot de son annuaire : tri de la boîte mail, fiches prospects, veille de prix, points investisseurs, relance de factures et entretien des bots. Chacun renvoie au prompt complet, avec crédit à son auteur.
t871.es: El autor ordenó por tarea 26 casos de uso de Grok Bot de su directorio: triaje del correo, informes de prospectos, vigilancia de precios, novedades para inversores, cobro de facturas y mantenimiento de bots. Cada uno enlaza al prompt completo y cita a quien lo compartió.
t871.de: Der Autor sortierte 26 Grok-Bot-Anwendungsfälle aus seinem Verzeichnis nach Aufgabe: Posteingang sortieren, Lead-Briefings, Preisbeobachtung, Investoren-Updates, Rechnungen nachfassen und Bot-Pflege. Jeder verlinkt den vollständigen Prompt mit Nennung der Quelle.
